work: Migrated the hidden mono-attraction Hill Szczęśliwicka legacy Park and its Gravity Slide parkItem to a published standalone alpine coaster; imported one exact credited photograph and published a Facebook announcement. Reconciled the separate Wiegand Warsaw candidate as a retained duplicate of this migration.
qualification: The site is an urban municipal sports hill and public park, not a structured amusement park. Its gravity coaster is a fixed separately visitable ride. The editor found the hidden legacy Park and its single Gravity Slide parkItem, but no matching standalone attraction. The city confirms the coaster continues during ski-lift modernisation and also in winter. Controlled migration marked the hidden legacy Park and item NotRelevant without deleting them.
sourceLimitations: The city publishes a variable dusk closing time, so no fixed weekly closing time was invented. The city notice and a local instructor site disagree on winter operation; the city notice is treated as authoritative, while visitors are asked to confirm the day’s operation.
No current ride-specific official fare was found, so no price was entered.

The legacy ride carried a 1999-01-01 opening date despite RCDB giving no precise opening date. This placeholder was cleared in a separate Apply. The inherited length is attributed to RCDB; it is not repeated in public prose because other sources describe a different overall route length.
The photograph dates from July 2015 and is labelled as historical; it does not document the current state of the works.
The legacy Park and parkItem remain hidden and NotRelevant. No destructive deletion was requested or performed.
